summary: RoomFit iteration 4 validation (web preview 390x844, https://roomfit-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: converted /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py to the new async job pattern. 6/6 pytest cases passed: root /api/, status CRUD (no _id leak), POST /api/floorplan/detect returns {job_id} (string, uuid-like), GET /api/floorplan/detect/{unknown} returns 404, polling returns status=error with detail 'AI recognition unavailable: the Universal Key balance is used up (top up in Profile → Universal Key)' — Budget-exceeded path correctly mapped to HTTP 402 via detect_floorplan() and surfaced in the job detail. Frontend: Upload a real floor plan (/app/tests/sample_floorplan.png) via upload-floorplan-zone file chooser works end-to-end with detection returning the budget-exhausted error: detection-note shows 'Automatic recognition failed (AI recognition unavailable: the Universal Key balance is used up ...). Outline the rooms manually in the next step.'; upload-plan-canvas renders the uploaded image (NOT the demo rectangle; demo-notice absent); upload-continue-button enabled. Dimensions step after upload: calibration-status='Uncalibrated — measurements unknown', no-rooms-notice visible, no 4.80×3.60 default rectangle — the uploaded image is correctly the source of truth. Manual segmentation works: mode-draw → 4 corner taps on editor-canvas-touch → finish-room-button ('Finish room (4)') adds a room; room-editor-card opens with the new room; room-kind-living applied; wall-chip-0 selects wall; known-wall-input=4.8 + apply-scale-button → calibration-status='Scale set · reference wall 4.80 m'; room-dims-text='4.80 m × 3.58 m (bounding) · usable area 17.2 m²'. Second room (bedroom kind) drawn and added. mode-door + 2 taps adds an opening (door counter on room row reads '1 doors'). mode-vertex switches cleanly. delete-room-button removes the bedroom; rooms count back to 1. Reload persistence: page.reload() on /plan/dimensions keeps calibration ('Scale set · reference wall 4.80 m') and the 1 drawn room — plan-store IndexedDB persistence works. Demo path end-to-end: try-demo-button → upload-continue → dimensions calibrated to 3.60 m → confirm → rooms (6 rooms: 2 Balcony, Living, Kitchen, 2 Bathroom); room-unsupported-notice shows for Balcony/Kitchen/Bathroom; Living Room has no notice and rooms-continue 'Furnish Living Room' is enabled. Furniture → Style (style-card-minimalist) → Budget ($2000) → Layouts: 'Set #1 · 3 of 3 layouts satisfy every constraint. Budget $2,000.' with 3 layout-plan-* items inside the real 4.80 m × 3.60 m Living Room polygon. select-layout-0 + layouts-continue → Shop reached → shop-continue → Results reached. Full flow works. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native issues detected: props.pointerEvents deprecation warning (carried over from iterations 2 & 3, non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still fires on initial load. Audit LinearGradient/Image props and move pointerEvents into style. Non-blocking; carried over from iterations 2 & 3.

action_items: LOW: Replace deprecated 'props.pointerEvents' usages with 'style.pointerEvents' to clear the remaining console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:151-174 — Async job pattern (DETECT_JOBS dict) correctly offloads the Gemini call so the ingress 60s timeout no longer kills /api/floorplan/detect. 'Budget has been exceeded' is translated to HTTP 402 inside detect_floorplan() and the job status transitions to {status:'error', detail:'AI recognition unavailable: the Universal Key balance is used up ...'}. Note: DETECT_JOBS is in-process memory — if the backend restarts, in-flight jobs are lost. Acceptable for this prototype; if deployed with multiple workers it would need a Redis/Mongo-backed store.

frontend/app/plan/upload.tsx:25-38 & 56-57 — runDetection() guards against stale updates by comparing a.imageUri !== uri before merging detection output; on failure, sets detection='failed' with the budget message. New upload resets to emptyApartment() so previous geometry/calibration/layouts are correctly wiped. Verified: real upload does NOT replace image with demo rectangle.

frontend/app/plan/dimensions.tsx:91-108 — finishRoom() requires >=3 corners (clear error message), appends to apartment.rooms immutably and switches mode back to 'select'. calibrate() validates range 0.5–30 m. wall-chip-<i> cleanly bypasses the earlier precise-tap issue identified in iter 3.

frontend/src/state/plan-store.tsx — Reload persistence confirmed within one browser context: calibration + rooms survive page.reload(). IndexedDB split (IMG_KEY for large imageUri + KEY for geometry/metadata) still works.

success_rate.frontend: All critical flows pass: real upload (budget-exhausted path handled gracefully, uploaded image is source of truth, continue enabled) → manual draw + per-room calibration + door/vertex/delete → persistence across reload. Demo path: upload → dimensions → rooms (unsupported notice for balcony/kitchen/bathroom) → furniture (living) → style(9 cards) → budget → layouts (3 valid inside polygon) → shop → results.

context_for_next_testing_agent: /api/floorplan/detect is now async (POST → {job_id}; GET /api/floorplan/detect/{id} → {status, result|detail}). Universal Key budget is currently exhausted so detection returns status=error with 'AI recognition unavailable...'. The frontend handles this gracefully via upload.tsx runDetection() failure branch. Playwright gotchas: (1) each mcp_browser_automation call is a fresh browser context — IndexedDB is NOT shared across calls, test reload-persistence within ONE script using page.reload(). (2) For React-Native-Web Pressable text extraction, use page.text_content() instead of inner_text() — inner_text sometimes returns '' due to RN-web rendering. (3) try-demo-button needs ~2s after upload mounts (plan-store hydration). (4) wall-chip-<i> is reliable for calibration; don't rely on precise tap on editor-canvas-touch for wall selection.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. Budget-exhausted path from the Universal Key is correctly surfaced to the user as a non-blocking warning that unlocks manual segmentation on the next step; the uploaded image is preserved as source of truth. Manual segmentation editor is robust (draw/finish/kind/calibrate/door/vertex/delete). Persistence survives reload within the same browser context. Full demo flow (upload → dimensions → rooms → furniture → style → budget → layouts → shop → results) still works end-to-end.
